# `time_bucket`

<!-- @generated by `cargo xtask docs-sql`; do not edit. -->

Returns the start of the bucket that `ts` falls into,
where buckets are defined by the given `bucketSize` interval aligned to optional `origin`.
For `TIMESTAMP_NTZ`, bucketing is performed in UTC. For `TIMESTAMP`, year-month
interval buckets and calendar-day components of day-time interval buckets align
to the session time zone.

**Applies to:** Krishiv 0.2.0 and above. Spark: 4.2 and later.

## Syntax

```text
time_bucket(bucketSize, ts[, origin])
```

## Details

| | |
|---|---|
| Krishiv | Implemented |
| Group | `datetime_funcs` |

| Added in Spark | 4.2.0 |
| In Spark profiles | 4.2 and later |
| Arguments | [2, 3] |
| Deterministic | yes |

## Examples

```sql
-- time_bucket, example 1
> SELECT time_bucket(INTERVAL '15' MINUTE, TIMESTAMP '2024-01-01 11:27:00', TIMESTAMP '1970-01-01 00:00:00');
2024-01-01 11:15:00
```

```sql
-- time_bucket, example 2
> SELECT time_bucket(INTERVAL '1' HOUR, TIMESTAMP '2024-01-01 11:27:00');
2024-01-01 11:00:00
```

```sql
-- time_bucket, example 3
> SELECT time_bucket(INTERVAL '1' MONTH, TIMESTAMP '2024-07-20 14:30:00', TIMESTAMP '2024-06-15 09:00:00');
2024-07-15 09:00:00
```
